sql.if: AND t1.agnt_amd_dt < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{srchEndDd} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + INTERVAL '1 day'

mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: AgentMapper.selectAgentCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_agent t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model md1 ON t1.agnt_model_id = md1.model_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: AgentMapper.selectAgentList */ t1.agnt_id , t1.agnt_nm , t1.agnt_model_id , md1.model_nm AS agnt_model_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd , cd1.mtcd_nm AS medata_set_sttus_mtcd_nm , t1.agnt_desc , t1.agnt_eng_nm , t1.agnt_eng_desc , t1.agnt_tel_no , t1.agnt_hpage , t1.agnt_regr_id , t1.agnt_regr_nm , to_char(t1.agnt_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS agnt_reg_dt , t1.agnt_amdr_id , t1.agnt_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.agnt_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS agnt_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_agent t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 ON cd1.mtcd = t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd AND cd1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model md1 ON t1.agnt_model_id = md1.model_id WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: AgentMapper.selectAgent */ t1.agnt_id , t1.agnt_nm , t1.agnt_model_id , md1.model_nm AS agnt_model_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd , t1.agnt_desc , t1.agnt_eng_nm , t1.agnt_eng_desc , t1.agnt_tel_no , t1.agnt_hpage , t1.agnt_regr_id , t1.agnt_regr_nm , to_char(t1.agnt_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS agnt_reg_dt , t1.agnt_amdr_id , t1.agnt_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.agnt_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS agnt_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_agent t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model md1 ON t1.agnt_model_id = md1.model_id WHERE t1.agnt_id = #{agntId}
